analysis.title: Essex Property Trust Inc. (ESS): 3Q26 Update: Adjusting Estimates and Price Target
key_insights: GS keeps ESS at Neutral and cuts its 12-month price target to $293 from $301, based on a Q5-Q8 FFO multiple of 17.1x versus 17.5x previously. Price was $273.32 at the 13 Nov 2026 close, implying 7.2% upside.

Estimates were updated for 3Q26 results, revised 2026 guidance and management commentary. The largest driver is lower JV income, because JV interest expense is higher, as management noted on the call.
Core FFO estimate shifts are 0%/-1%/-2% for 2026/2027/2028. That leaves GS in line with Visible Alpha consensus for 2026, 1% below for 2027 and in line for 2028.
Full-year 2026 core FFO guidance was raised to $16.10-$16.22, a $16.16 midpoint, from a $16.14 midpoint. The new midpoint is slightly below GS ($16.18) and consensus ($16.20).
FY26 same-store revenue, expense and NOI growth guidance midpoints improved to 2.9%/2.8%/3% from 2.8%/2.8%/2.8%.
4Q core FFO guidance is $3.95-$4.07, a $4.01 midpoint, versus GS at $4.02 and consensus at $4.05. The midpoint is below both.
The price target also reflects a refreshed relationship between REIT growth rates (2025-2027E) and NTM FFO multiples, which sets the merited multiple.

market_movers.rationale: Target lowered from $301 on a lower Q5-Q8 FFO multiple (17.1x vs 17.5x) and reduced 2027/2028 FFO estimates. Rating stays Neutral with 7.2% upside to the target.

FY26 same-store revenue/expense/NOI growth guidance midpoints (company) are 2.9%/2.8%/3%, versus prior midpoints of 2.8%/2.8%/2.8%.

risk_factors: Greater or less than expected supply pressures in ESS markets.
Improvement or deterioration in rental demand.
Acquisitions and development yields above or below expectations and underwriting.
Higher JV interest expense, which is already reducing JV income.
